svg.title: HMO Equipment Deployment Workflow
svg.desc: 8-step deployment workflow for the QR-based equipment management system
svg.text: ~1 working day total | 8 steps | Weeks 3-5 of roadmap
Upload .xlsx to Google Drive, rename, copy Sheet ID, verify 5 sheets
Borrow, Return, Maintenance, Report Damage — link responses to Sheet
Update Landing Page with Form URLs
Replace FORM_ID placeholders in FORMS object (~line 1234), host on GitHub Pages
If hosting URL differs from hmo-equipment.github.io, regenerate QR codes
Print A4, cut labels. Vinyl for OBS/LAB (waterproof), paper for HPC/NET
54 physical labels across 5 rooms: P204 (21), P206 (20), P207 (9), P401 (8), T3 (9)
Paste script into Sheet, set MASTER_SHEET_ID, run setup(), grant Gmail permissions
Search "AWAC" or scan QR on phone, submit test borrow form, verify Sheet entry
Run overdue check from Sheet menu, confirm email arrives at datpt@hus.edu.vn
15-20 min demo: scan QR, fill borrow/return form, explain approval process
Section managers get extra training on maintenance & damage report forms
